note: Dunn County (WI) publishes its general zoning polygons (2021, 2023) only as ESRI geodatabase zip downloads via GeoData@Wisconsin (web.s3.wisc.edu/rml-gisdata/DUNN_ZONING_2023.zip), with no ArcGIS REST service; the county zoning page links only a PDF map (Zoning_Districts.pdf). The county's ArcGIS Online org (9QRFLTGaomYPrxH4) has no zoning layer (only Unincorporated boundaries). The Beacon viewer is Schneider-hosted and not queryable. Menomonie city, Elk Mound and Colfax villages zone themselves; their zoning is only PDF maps or code text, no service found. Statewide 2017 SCO shapefile zip did not yield features in validation.
